title: The Automated Scab
logline: A massive, fully automated mining rig is devouring a local asteroid field, and displaced miners hire a pilot to rip out its faulty targeting processor.

roles.description: Old-school rock hopper, hates machines, loves explosives.
Brilliant, completely detached from the human cost of their inventions.
A colossal, mindless drone ship eating asteroids.
A pristine corporate spire in the neighboring system.
The local union, currently out of work.

public_situation: The new {role:automated_mining_rig} has arrived, immediately putting thousands of independent prospectors out of work.
private_truth: The rig's automation is highly experimental and suffering from a botched software update pushed by the tech evangelist to cut corners.

beats.public_change: The rig mistakenly chews up an empty civilian transport, blaming 'navigational error'.

missions.reason: The miner hires the pilot to blast off the rig's external sensor array and steal the targeting matrix.
missions.private_fact: The rig is heavily armored and will fight back.

missions.reason: The evangelist hires the pilot to run diagnostics on the rig's targeting sensors.
missions.private_fact: The evangelist is trying to cover up the software bugs.

beats.public_change: The rig activates its self-defense protocols and begins firing on any ship that approaches.

missions.reason: The pilot must disable the rig's secondary weapon drones before they massacre the protesting miners.
missions.private_fact: The drones are coordinating using an off-site corporate server.

beats.public_change: The rig's manufacturer issues a system-wide recall, but the rig's receiver is damaged.

missions.reason: The pilot must travel to the corporate HQ and scan their servers to find the hard-kill override frequency.
missions.private_fact: The tech evangelist discovers the intrusion and tracks the pilot.

beats.public_change: The rig begins moving toward a populated station, blindly categorizing its metal hull as high-yield scrap.

missions.reason: The pilot must return and destroy the rig's core processors before its drills breach the station.
missions.private_fact: From the rig's command module, the tech evangelist hails the pilot, offering a fortune if they let the rig 'test' its capabilities on the station.

resolutions.summary: The monstrous machine is reduced to scrap. The corporation is humiliated, and the independent miners get their jobs back.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew up a billion-credit corporate mining drone to save local jobs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the evangelist's offer.
resolutions.summary: The rig devours the station, killing hundreds. The evangelist calls it a 'valuable data gathering exercise'.
The rig eats half the station before breaking down on its own. The fallout ruins everyone.

loose_threads.detail: The rig's faulty targeting logs show it was specifically programmed to prioritize ships owned by independent miners.
The tech evangelist casually mentions their emergency funding comes from a shell company registered to the mining guild's own leadership.

radio_hooks: Corporate mining drone malfunctions; independent miners celebrate.
Evangelist {role:tech_evangelist} promises automated future is safe.

voice_direction.displaced_miner: Loud, boisterous, constantly complaining about modern technology.
voice_direction.tech_evangelist: Fast, precise, completely devoid of empathy.
